title: Marble Legs
description: Reverse lunges and hip thrust strength work, then dynamic core with hollow hold and bear hold

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Fast march in place
exercises.instructions: March quickly in place, swinging your arms

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Reverse lunges
exercises.instructions: Big step backward, lower the knee

exercises.name: Floor hip thrust
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, feet flat, lift hips, squeeze glutes

exercises.name: Sissy squat
exercises.instructions: Lean back, knees drive forward, quads on fire

exercises.name: Single-leg deadlift
exercises.instructions: Hinge your torso, one leg lifts behind you, keep your balance

exercises.name: Hollow hold
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, arms and legs extended above the floor, lower back pressed down

exercises.name: Leg raises
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift straight legs to vertical

exercises.name: Scissor kicks
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, cross alternating over and under

exercises.name: Bear hold
exercises.instructions: On all fours, knees hovering 2cm off the floor, hold

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
